verdict.rationale: Fivetran's own connector docs list re-sync at both connection level and table level, so a single table can be resynced without rebuilding the pipeline. A community report also confirms full re-syncs were performed. However, the table-level evidence comes from a single connector page (Akamai), and nothing documents backfilling history over a chosen range. missing for 10: evidence that table-level resync is available across connectors, a documented historical backfill capability, details on how to trigger a resync via the UI or API, and independent hands-on corroboration of a table-level resync.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can backfill history or resync a single table without rebuilding the whole pipeline

citations.quote: Re-sync | YES | Connection level and table level. A parent table re-sync includes all associated child tables.
We even had to do a full re-sync on a couple of occasions (which to their credit they did for no charge).
